title: Signage development examples
slide_intent: Teach designers to adapt information density to a sign’s shape and the visitor’s approach.
strategic_value: Abbeydale and Weston Park can each announce their own venue using distinct colors while the shared seal identifies the museum family.
demonstration: The upright turquoise Abbeydale sign stacks amenities and a direction. The wide yellow Weston Park sign gives the venue lettering most of its width and places supporting information beside it.
practical_value: Use a tall stack for a directional stop and a wide name-led arrangement for a venue identifier.

content_islands.name: Abbeydale sign study
content_islands.spec: Show the upright turquoise sign in its outdoor setting. Stack venue lettering, amenities, descriptive copy, arrow and seal.

content_islands.name: Weston Park sign study
content_islands.spec: Show the wide yellow panel against the landscape. Place the large venue mark at left and group visitor details and seal at right.
